name: FIEZEL PTE Academic Official Templates & Nakul Master Scaffolds
description: Standardized pedagogical templates designed for guaranteed scoring in Pearson AI automated grading algorithms (Target PTE 42–58+).

describe_image.title: Nakul 5-Line Universal Describe Image Template
structure: Line 1 (Type & Topic): The image provided is a [type] that gives information about [topic].
Line 2 (Axes / Breakdown): While the x-axis represents [categories], the y-axis shows [values].
Line 3 (Maximum Trend): It is evident that [highest feature] has the highest value.
Line 4 (Minimum Trend): Conversely, [lowest feature] has the lowest value.
Line 5 (Conclusion): Overall, this image clearly illustrates [restate topic].
describe_image.text: The given image represents an informative [type] regarding [topic]. While the x-axis represents [categories], the y-axis shows [values]. It is evident that [highest feature] has the highest value. Conversely, [lowest feature] has the lowest value. Overall, this image clearly illustrates [restate topic].

fill_guide.type: bar chart / line graph / pie chart / diagram / table
fill_guide.topic: Title or main subject of the chart/diagram
fill_guide.categories: Categories shown along horizontal axis or legend
fill_guide.values: Numerical values or percentages along vertical axis
fill_guide.highest feature: The peak bar, year, or segment with largest number
fill_guide.lowest feature: The lowest bar, year, or segment with smallest number

tips: Speak steadily for 25–28 seconds; stop before 30s to avoid rushing or getting cut off.
No pauses longer than 2 seconds (Pearson's 3-second silence rule will automatically shut off the mic).
Do not self-correct if you misread a number; maintain continuous vocal acoustic flow.

retell_lecture.title: Nakul 5-Sentence Retell Lecture Template
retell_lecture.text: The lecture discusses [topic]. In the beginning, the speaker explained [phrase 1]. Later, the speaker said that [phrase 2]. Here, the speaker also mentioned [phrase 3]. In conclusion, the lecture effectively summarized [phrase 4].
tips: Capture 4 to 6 noun phrases during audio playback without worrying about grammar.
Insert the captured keywords directly into the slots with calm, rhythmic pacing.

summarize_written_text.title: Nakul Strict 1-Sentence Summarizer Scaffold
summarize_written_text.rules: Strictly ONE single sentence (35-45 words), one capital letter at beginning, exactly one full stop at end.
tips: Never place more than one period in the entire response.
Pick 2-3 key independent clauses from the text and join them with 'and' and 'although'.

summarize_spoken_text.title: Nakul Short Connectors Spoken Summarizer
summarize_spoken_text.formula: The audio discusses [topic]. Firstly, [point 1]. Secondly, [point 2]. Furthermore, [point 3]. In conclusion, [point 4].
tips: Avoid bulky 40-word filler templates that waste cognitive load.
Write 3-4 short sentences using simple connectors: Firstly, Secondly, Furthermore, In conclusion.

write_from_dictation.title: Nakul Extra Words Hack & Zero Negative Marking Protocol
write_from_dictation.rules: 1 point per correct word. Zero negative marking. Order does not invalidate points.
write_from_dictation.hack_guide: If you are unsure whether a word is singular or plural (e.g. student or students), or unsure of tense (develop, develops, developed), or article (the, a), write BOTH variations: 'student students', 'the a'. Pearson AI matches tokens without deducting marks for extraneous guesses.
tips: Always write down the initial letter of each word while listening to capture the entire sentence.
Ensure capitalization of the first word and proper nouns.
Add a full stop at the end.

paragraphs.scaffold: In the contemporary era, whether [Topic] remains a subject of considerable controversy. While some individuals argue that [View A], others firmly maintain that [View B]. In my perspective, I concur with the former viewpoint for several compelling reasons.

To begin with, the foremost justification is that [Argument 1]. Specifically, [Supporting Evidence 1]. For example, empirical studies conducted in recent years have demonstrated that [Concrete Example 1]. Consequently, it is evident that [Concluding thought 1].

Furthermore, another pivotal factor that should be considered is that [Argument 2]. In other words, [Supporting Evidence 2]. To illustrate, modern organizations and academic institutions frequently observe that [Concrete Example 2]. Hence, this clearly reinforces the significance of the issue.

In conclusion, after evaluating the aforementioned perspectives, I reiterate that although alternative viewpoints exist, [Rephrased Thesis]. Therefore, taking proactive measures regarding this matter will undoubtedly yield long-term advantages.
